_comment: exact = whole-string overrides; terms = names protected/translated inside sentences (case-sensitive, whole words). Policy: GW2 proper names, boons, conditions and crafting materials stay in English; only names with an established Italian form are translated. patterns = whole-line rules for item names, {X} = the prefix words (e.g. "{X} Longbow": "Arco lungo {X}").
